\[
d_k \cdot 10^k + d_{k-1} \cdot 10^{k-1} + \cdots + d_1 \cdot 10 + d_0 = 2 \left( d_k \cdot 7^k + d_{k-1} \cdot 7^{k-1} + \cdots + d_1 \cdot 7 + d_0 \right)
\]

Rewriting this equation, we get:

\[
\sum_{i=0}^{k} d_i (10^i - 2 \cdot 7^i) = 0
\]

We analyze the coefficients \( 10^i - 2 \cdot 7^i \) for different values of \( i \). For \( i = 0 \) and \( i = 1 \), the coefficients are negative, while for \( i \geq 2 \), they are positive.

Maximizing \( N \) involves maximizing \( d_2 \), \( d_1 \), and \( d_0 \). Setting \( d_2 = 6 \), we solve:
